hints.title: Drink State Alternation
hints.text: At each hour, we are either drinking beverage A or beverage B. Switching drinks incurs a one-hour cooldown with zero energy gain.

hints.title: State Machine Transitions
hints.text: Drinking A at hour i can either continue drinking A from hour i-1 (gaining A[i]) or switch from drinking B at hour i-1 (spending hour i on cooldown, gaining 0).

hints.title: Memory Optimization
hints.text: Only the previous hour state is required, permitting O(1) auxiliary space.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass updating state machine registers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive exploration of 2^n drinking schedules times out exponentially.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models cooldown penalties with state machine dynamic programming.
